title: Introduce TFState Lease Transactor and GPU Topology Mapper
author: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Adds a new terraform module (tfstate-lease-transactor) and an operator-style helper (gpu-topology-mapper) to better separate tfstate ownership for tenant GPU leases from nodepool lifecycle, and to map GPU topology to tenant-level network slices. Motivation: Private installs have increasing drift and outage surface from tightly-coupled tfstate files that contain both network and ephemeral GPU lease state. This causes rollbacks and upgrades to be risky in multi-tenant private deployments. The new transactor introduces a small stateful orchestration layer that serializes lease handoff, provides a compact lease index for fast reconcilers, and enables a safer migration path (non-destructive) for existing tfstate layouts. The topology mapper improves scheduling affinity by emitting consistent nodeclass -> tenant network annotations and a small mapping CRD for the installer to consume. What changed (high level): - New terraform module: modules/tfstate-lease-transactor (handles separate backend configs, locking semantics, lease index object schema, and migration helpers). - New helm chart patch and k8s manifests: charts/private-installer/templates/gpu-topology-mapper-deployment.yaml and CRD for gpu.topology.redwood.ai/v1alpha1. - Migration tooling: tools/tfstate/lease-migrate.sh and a Go helper cli that performs dry-run and apply paths. - Minor refactors: modules/gpu-nodepool updated to emit nodeclass labels compatible with the mapper; IAM role module additions to allow transactor service account to assume lease owner role. - CI infra: added e2e test spec in test/e2e/gpu-lease-migration.spec and a lightweight local runner for CI. Commits summary: "initial transactor module scaffolding"; "implement lease index and locking primitives"; "add migration dry-run; unit tests"; "gpu-topology-mapper controller and CRD"; "helm chart integration and docs"; "fix IAM role scoping and unit tests"; "ci: add e2e gating and retry on flaky migration test" Files changed (representative): - modules/tfstate-lease-transactor/{main.tf,outputs.tf,variables.tf,README.md} - charts/private-installer/templates/gpu-topology-mapper-deployment.yaml - charts/private-installer/templates/gpu-topology-mapper-crd.yaml - modules/gpu-nodepool/variables.tf - modules/iam/roles.tf - tools/tfstate/lease-migrate.sh - pkg/installer/topology/mapper/controller.go - test/e2e/gpu-lease-migration.spec - docs/private-deploy/lease-transactor-migration.md Testing: Local unit tests for the transactor module (terraform validate + terratest style), controller unit tests in Go, and an e2e scenario in a k3d cluster that exercises migration dry-run/apply and verifies node labels/annotations are consistent post-migrate. CI: initial run showed a single flaky e2e failure (migration test timeout) which was addressed by adding an exponential backoff and increased timeout; final CI status is green. Backwards compatibility and migration plan: - Migration is opt-in. By default installs continue to use current tfstate layout. - operators can run tools/tfstate/lease-migrate.sh --dry-run to produce a report of proposed state moves and a safe apply plan. - The transactor only takes over leases when the apply completes and a consensus lock is acquired. - Rollback path is provided: migration produces a state snapshot and a revert plan; the transactor will honor the snapshot to restore prior ownership. Rollout plan and risk mitigation: - Canary on internal staging clusters for 2 weeks; then opt-in beta with customer success for 3 tenant installs; observe for lease-granularity regressions. - Keep previous nodepool lifecycle path as fallback by setting a feature flag in values.yaml. - Monitor metrics introduced: transactor.leases_acquired_total, transactor.acquire_latency_ms, mapper.mapped_nodes, and migration.dry_run_reports. Review highlights (single string timeline): Reviewer Marco Liang: "High-level: nice separation. Please clarify lock semantics for cross-region installs and add an integration test that simulates concurrent lease requests." Author reply (Aisha): "Added a locking section in the module README and added a simulated concurrent request test to e2e; lock uses per-lease index with sequenced tokens and Terraform state locker as a last-resort guard." Reviewer Riley Thompson: "IAM scoping looks broad; can we tighten the assumeRole policy and require a pointer to customer KMS for rotation?" Author reply: "Tightened assumeRole to sts:AssumeRole for only transactor SA + explicit resource ARNs; KMS pointer added to module variables with a note in README for enterprise installs." Reviewer Samira Gomez: "Please add migration dry-run to changelog and ensure non-root users can execute the CLI." Author: "Fixed - CLI now supports delegated users via kubeconfig contexts and we added non-root install docs." Merge notes: squash merge after green CI; release note entry added. Related Linear tickets: ENG-4529 (tfstate split for private installs), ENG-4580 (gpu topology mapping and affinity). Related Jira: SUP-7891 (customer-reported private upgrade drift). Known limitations and follow-ups: - Cross-account tfstate replication is not implemented (follow-up ENG-4692). - Mapper currently supports only Nvidia A100 and H100 profiles; adding other GPU families planned. - Need to add RBAC audit hooks for transactor operations. Documentation: docs/private-deploy/lease-transactor-migration.md contains operator-facing steps, sample terraform var blocks, and rollback instructions. Merge outcome: merged to main via squash on 2026-02-24.
release_notes: Adds opt-in TFState Lease Transactor to decouple GPU lease ownership from nodepool lifecycle; introduces GPU Topology Mapper and migration tooling; includes IAM scoping and rollback plans.
